results.title: BNP Paribas (EPA:BNP) Revenue - Stock Analysis
results.snippet: BNP Paribas had revenue of 13.04B EUR in the quarter ending June 30, 2026, with 12.47% growth. This brings the company's total for the last twelve months to 50.07B, up 8.52% year-over-year. In the year 2025, BNP Paribas had annual revenue of 47.67B with 4.47% growth. That makes BNP Paribas the 215th largest company in the world by revenue and 11th in France.
